title: $1.7 million Lahaina parcel for evacuation route
summary: On February 19, 2025, the committee voted eight to zero, with one member excused, to recommend adopting Resolution 25-49 in a revised CD1 version that corrects the property owner's names. The resolution would let the County buy a Lahaina parcel the Office of Recovery wants for a community corridor project. The managing director cited roadway evacuation routes, but one member called the $1.7 million price excessive for an undeveloped half acre, and the chair said this parcel alone would not create an evacuation route.
